history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young Indonesian soldier in a camouflage uniform and green beret stands in the foreground, facing the camera with a confident smile and sunglasses. He wears a tactical vest over his uniform, a black backpack, and a watch on his left wrist. His right hand is raised, giving a thumbs-up gesture. In the background, other soldiers in similar uniforms are visible, some blurred, suggesting they are in motion or further away. The setting appears to be an outdoor military compound, with a building and patterned roofing visible. The lighting is bright and natural, casting soft shadows. The dominant colors are green, brown, and black from the camouflage, with accents of red on the uniform insignia. The mood is positive and assertive.
